files.production_audit.sql:
WITH pages AS MATERIALIZED(
SELECT p.*,r.manifest_text,r.input_versions expected_versions,r.source_admission_sha256,e.details admission,
jsonb_build_object('manifest_text',r.manifest_text,'manifest_sha256',r.manifest_text_sha256,'source_admission_event_id',r.source_admission_event_id,'source_admission_sha256',r.source_admission_sha256) binding,
coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(z) order by z.page_number) from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.raw_minute_page_v3 z where z.request_sha256=p.request_sha256 and z.page_number<p.page_number),'[]'::jsonb) prior_chain
FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.raw_minute_page_v3 p JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.raw_minute_request_v3 r USING(request_sha256) JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_event e ON e.event_id=r.source_admission_event_id WHERE r.source_admission_event_id=159588),
digests AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT *,encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('page',submission,'reservation',commit_receipt->'reservation','input_versions',expected_versions,'prior_chain',prior_chain,'source_binding',binding)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') expected_digest FROM pages),
chains AS(SELECT p.request_sha256,encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by p.page_number)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') chain_sha FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.raw_minute_page_v3 p JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.raw_minute_request_v3 r USING(request_sha256) WHERE r.source_admission_event_id=159588 GROUP BY p.request_sha256)
SELECT count(*) pages,sum(wire_bytes) wire_bytes,sum((validation->>'result_count')::bigint) source_occurrences,
count(*) filter(where stored_sha256 is distinct from encode(sha256(convert_to(content_text,'UTF8')),'hex')) content_hash_mismatches,
count(*) filter(where input_versions is distinct from expected_versions or source_admission_sha256 is distinct from encode(sha256(convert_to(admission::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) binding_mismatches,
count(*) filter(where commit_receipt->>'output_sha256' is distinct from expected_digest or commit_receipt->'source_binding' is distinct from binding) digest_mismatches,
count(*) filter(where not exists(select 1 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_commit c where c.attempt_id=d.attempt_id and c.receipt=d.commit_receipt and c.output_sha256=d.expected_digest)) receipt_mismatches,
count(*) filter(where not exists(select 1 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.raw_minute_reservation_v3 r join population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_provider_lease l using(attempt_id) where r.attempt_id=d.attempt_id and r.receipt=d.commit_receipt->'reservation' and r.prior_chain_sha256=encode(sha256(convert_to(d.prior_chain::text,'UTF8')),'hex') and l.released_at is not null and l.received_bytes=d.wire_bytes)) reservation_lease_mismatches,
count(*) filter(where validation->>'terminal'='true') terminal_pages,
(select count(*) from chains c join population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_task t on t.checkpoint->>'raw_chain_sha256'=c.chain_sha where t.payload->>'kind'='RAW_RETAINED_VERIFY_ONLY_V1' and t.status='COMPLETE' and t.executions=1 and t.max_executions=1 and t.checkpoint->>'raw_phase'='RAW_RETAINED_VERIFIED' and exists(select 1 from population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_commit k join population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_attempt a using(attempt_id) where k.task_id=t.task_id and a.task_id=t.task_id and a.outcome='COMPLETE' and a.ended_at is not null and k.commit_key='raw-retained-verified-v1:'||t.task_id and k.output_sha256=c.chain_sha and k.receipt->>'output_sha256'=c.chain_sha and k.receipt->>'new_http_invocations'='0' and k.receipt->>'new_provider_requests'='0' and k.receipt->>'normalization_dispatched'='false' and k.receipt->>'family_accepted'='false' and k.receipt->'input_versions'=t.input_versions)) fully_verified_matching_retained_chains,
encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('request',request_sha256,'page',page_number,'stored_sha256',stored_sha256,'output_sha256',expected_digest) order by request_sha256,page_number)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') aggregate_manifest_sha256 FROM digests d;
